- File surface: `packages/spec/src/data/field.zod.ts` — `unique: UniqueScopeSchema.default(false)` (:939) becomes type-conditional: an `autonumber` field with no explicit `unique` resolves to the organization-composite scope (`'organization'`, the `case_number` template), every other type keeps `false`; the explicit opt-out spelling (`unique: false` written by the author) and its docblock (when opting out is legitimate — display-only sequence numbers); the autonumber block (:1620–:1650) and `RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES` (:187) docblocks; pins (default resolves, explicit opt-out honoured, other types unchanged, generated JSON Schema); changeset `minor` with the BREAKING banner + ADR-0087 disposition; generated artifacts regenerated. Measurement-only surfaces (read, report; ⛔ not edited here): `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` (:11854 unique-index creation — what happens today when the index cannot be created over existing duplicate rows: loud failure naming rows, generic failure, or silent skip/degrade), `packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/duplicates.ts` (already treats `type: 'autonumber'` as an identifier for the duplicate scan), `packages/objectql/src/tenancy/system-write-organization.ts`.
- Container & model: cloud session, `claude-fable-5-1`.
- Clause-②: **yes** — path limb `packages/spec/src/**`; content limb: the published autonumber contract's default changes (accept set unchanged, emitted shape changes; a declared `unique` now materialises where none did). Contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`; PR stays draft with `needs:contract-review` on both carriers.
- Serial constraints: `field.zod.ts` shared with #13879 (this seat, same round) on a region split — #13879 writes the `requiredWhen` / bounds describe texts; this card writes `unique` (:939) + the autonumber block only; #13879 lands first, this branch rebases before its final push. PR #14773 (draft) is open on `sql-driver.ts` ⇒ that file is measurement-only here; any engine/driver/cli change the measurement calls for is a stop-and-report branch (this seat files the engine-lane card and blocks this one on it), never a rider.
- Premise re-read on `origin/main` `2263ca4d6`: `unique` defaults to `false` for every field type including `autonumber` (:939); `duplicates.ts:428` and `seed-tenancy-backfill.ts:1276` both call autonumber values "unique" identifiers while nothing makes them so by default. Premise holds. Refs #12394 (closed, PR #12554 merged) and #8686 (closed) are landed fixes — the PR body records the interaction as the card asks. H17 on-hold trigger-file index (#9857, 01:59Z) names none of these files.

The dev leaves its own `Claim:` comment below (its own session id + branch + `Clause-②: yes`); the assignee stays the PM's.

Dispatch text handed to the dev, in brief (the ruling direction and the five design constraints are quoted verbatim from the card body — filed per the maintainer's hotcrm#1301 ruling — and marked non-renegotiable):
- Scope fences: lands in `packages/spec` only (default flip, opt-out spelling, docblocks, pins, changeset `minor` + BREAKING banner + ADR-0087 disposition, regenerated artifacts). ⛔ No edits to drivers (PR #14773 is open on `sql-driver.ts`), cli, objectql or metadata-protocol — measurement surfaces here; ⛔ no configuration surface beyond the opt-out spelling (constraint 1); #12394 / #8686 are landed fixes — constraint 3 is a PR-body paragraph plus any pin that flips.
- **Measurement first, with a closed decision rule** (constraint 2): M1 reproduce what an operator sees today when a declared `unique` cannot be materialised over existing duplicate rows (loud naming rows / loud naming the index / warning-and-continue / silent skip or downgrade); M2 what `os migrate` duplicates (`packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/duplicates.ts`, which already classifies autonumber as an identifier) reports for that table. Loud ⇒ implement the flip and record both readings verbatim in the PR (no rows/remedy in the message ⇒ an unassigned engine-lane finding). Warning-and-continue or silent ⇒ STOP on the flip, deliver the measurement as a `blocked` report with the reproduction pushed — this seat files the engine-lane card and blocks this one on it. ⛔ The driver is not "fixed" to make the flip landable.
- PM mechanism hypotheses to measure, evidence back to the PM: H1 the flip is type-conditional at parse time on `unique: UniqueScopeSchema.default(false)` (absent on an `autonumber` field ⇒ `'organization'`, other types unchanged), materialised where the driver's `isUniqueScopeDeclared(f?.unique)` reads — after reading why the `autonumberFormat` block deliberately avoids a parse-time default; H2 explicit `unique: false` is the opt-out (Zod default applies only when absent), docblock says when that is legitimate; H3 the `case_number` template is what the default resolves to; H4 generated artifacts (JSON Schema, authorable-surface baseline, references) regenerate with the tooling; H5 a consumer table for every reader of the parsed `unique` (objectui = PM's reading); H6 the corpus (examples, platform-objects, apps, dogfood fixtures) — every autonumber field the default now covers, fixtures seeding duplicates fixed in the data; H7 whole-repo pin sweep, flipped pins keep bearing weight; H8 the changeset's migration paragraph carries M1/M2 and the opt-out.
- Serial constraint: `field.zod.ts` is region-split with #13879 (same seat, same round) — this card writes `unique` (:939), the autonumber block and `RUNTIME_OWNED_FIELD_TYPES` only; #13879 lands first, this branch merges `origin/main` before its final push (regenerate after the merge commit).
- Gates: 42 commands derived at `2263ca4d6` handed as a clue; re-derived by the dev on the actual diff after the changeset exists; CI on the draft PR is the final reading. Board reading (485 open issues, 06:09Z) handed once.
- Clause ② landing: draft PR with `Fixes #13894` + `needs:contract-review` in the same stroke (this seat mirrors the label onto the card and subscribes to the PR the moment it exists); never flipped to ready by the dev. Cloud self-drive clauses: legal turn endings are push + draft PR + report, or a `blocked` report with the evidence pushed; `os-dev-report` comment first, then the final JSON.
